description: The scroll primitive for a full-viewport vertical media feed. It owns layout, gesture and resource policy, and composes the item presentation as its child. A pager cannot stand in for it: a pager assumes a countable set, and this one is unbounded.

MUST: Fill the viewport with one item and snap per item.
Claim the vertical axis only, and be the only gesture axis in its region.
Ship wheel and arrow-key equivalents alongside the gesture.
Decode and play the current item, prefetch its immediate neighbours, and release distant ones. Bounded memory on a low-end device is a contract, not an optimisation.
Take the data-saver mode as an input, and vary prefetch depth and decode policy by it.
Emit the exposure event itself. It is the only thing that knows what was actually seen, so every reach figure downstream depends on it rather than on an approximation.
Restore scroll position when navigation returns to it.
Keep reading order correct across recycled items, and place no live region on anything that re-renders more than once a second.
SHOULD: Snap without animated physics under reduced motion, removing no information.
NEVER: Page a nested media set horizontally inside itself. The set pages in the detail view, which is its own region.
Advance on a timer without a user-visible clock and a gesture that overrides it.
Reserve a slot for promoted or sponsored items.
